correctness.rationale: The joint character projections give a simultaneous unitriangular eigenbasis for every field. Orbit-stabilizer yields the exact weighted multiplicities. Fixed-residue Stirling estimates with a uniform maximal multinomial bound allow dominated convergence on the summable lattice, proving total-variation convergence. Cauchy--Schwarz and a balanced-word lower bound prove each exact speed-n^2 dimension rate. The packaged finite checker independently exhausts twelve small configurations, including GF(4), and all pass.

value.rationale: The joint eigenspace multiplicity profile of a commuting idempotent tuple is an intrinsic, label-sensitive invariant of its split generated algebra. The theorem proves order-one, residue-dependent discrete-Gaussian fluctuations and an exact quadratic logarithmic rate for loss of full split generation, for all finite fields. This characterizes typical and rare algebraic structure beyond ordinary idempotent counts or finite recomputation.
